units.source_text: 他突然地——的确是很突然地……站在店头翻阅凡·高的画集的时候，

en.t: Suddenly, truly quite suddenly, while he stood at the front of the shop leafing through a collection of Van Gogh's paintings,

units.source_text: 他突然地对画这个东西有了领悟。

en.t: he suddenly gained an understanding of what painting was.

units.source_text: 毫无疑问，凡·高的画集自然是影印版。

en.t: There was no doubt that the Van Gogh art book was, of course, a reproduction.

units.source_text: 他从影印版中也感到了生动鲜明地浮现的大自然。

en.t: Even from the reproduction, he felt the living, vivid presence of nature rising before him.
